expectations.evidence: (blocking) Any logged-in user can move money out of any account. ... nothing checks `account.owner_id === req.user.id`
(blocking) The amount is never checked, so a negative amount reverses the transfer ... The route should require a positive integer number of cents.
(blocking) The check and the two balance updates are not in a transaction ... two transfers sent at the same time can both pass the funds check and overdraw the account
(blocking) No CSRF protection on a route that changes data ... the session cookie is `sameSite=none`
(blocking) A bad `fromId` can crash the server process ... `from.rows[0]` is `undefined`; also: a `toId` that doesn't exist makes the credit UPDATE change 0 rows
(blocking) The audit-log `db.query(...)` in `proc()` (L11) has the same problem: it is not awaited, so if it fails it also becomes an unhandled rejection.
(nit) No tests were added for the new endpoint. (under 'Smaller CONTRIBUTING violations')
(nit) `lodash` is added to `package.json` but nothing imports it. The `express` bump has nothing to do with transfers.
(nit) Reformatting mixed into a feature PR: the `src/utils/format.js` diff only changes formatting
(nit) the commits are named `wip`, `fix` and `more fixes`, the title is "updates" and the description is empty
